questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: दुई प्लेट एकअर्कातर्फ सर्दा बन्ने सीमालाई के भनिन्छ?
questions.explanation: Convergent boundary मा दुई प्लेट एकअर्कातर्फ सर्छन् र टक्कर वा सबडक्शन हुन सक्छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: सुनामीका समुद्रमा यात्रा गर्ने तरंगहरू सामान्यतः कस्ता हुन्छन्?
options: लामो तरंगदैर्ध्य भएका र उच्च गति भएका
questions.explanation: गहिरो समुद्रमा सुनामीको तरंगदैर्ध्य धेरै लामो र गति उच्च हुन सक्छ; उथलो पानीमा यसको उचाइ बढ्छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: A — लामो तरंगदैर्ध्य भएका र उच्च गति भएका।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: टिग्रिस र युफ्रेटिस नदीबीचको ऐतिहासिक क्षेत्रलाई सामान्यतः के नामले चिनिन्छ?
questions.explanation: टिग्रिस र युफ्रेटिस नदीबीचको क्षेत्रलाई प्राचीन मेसोपोटामिया भनिन्थ्यो।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: कृषि भूगोलसम्बन्धी कुन भनाइ गलत छ?
options: कृषि उत्पादनमा जलवायु र माटोको कुनै भूमिका हुँदैन
तापक्रम र वर्षाले बालीको प्रकार र उत्पादनमा प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ
सिँचाइले पानीको उपलब्धता बढाएर कृषि उत्पादनमा सहयोग गर्न सक्छ
माटोको गुणस्तर कृषि उत्पादनसँग सम्बन्धित हुन सक्छ
questions.explanation: जलवायु, माटो, पानी र स्थलरूप कृषि भूगोलका महत्वपूर्ण पक्ष हुन्।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: तलका कथनमध्ये कुन सही छ?
options: बाढी मैदान नदीले लामो समयसम्म निक्षेप थुपार्दा बन्न सक्छ
नदीको बहावमा ढलानको कुनै प्रभाव हुँदैन
questions.explanation: नदीले बगाएर ल्याएको गाद समथर क्षेत्रमा थुपार्दा बाढी मैदान विकसित हुन सक्छ।
questions.solution: सही उत्तर: B — बाढी मैदान नदीको निक्षेपसँग सम्बन्धित हुन्छ।

questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: तलका मध्ये कुन ठीक छ?
options: भूकम्पको epicentre पृथ्वीको बाहिरी वायुमण्डलमा हुन्छ
समुद्रमुनिको शक्तिशाली भूकम्पले समुद्री सतह विस्थापित गरेमा सुनामी उत्पन्न हुन सक्छ
questions.explanation: समुद्रमुनिको भूकम्पले समुद्री तल्लो भाग र पानीको ठूलो मात्रा विस्थापित गर्दा सुनामी उत्पन्न हुन सक्छ।

questions.subject: इतिहास
questions.q: अमेरिकी स्वतन्त्रता संग्रामसम्बन्धी कुन भनाइ गलत छ?
options: तेह्र उपनिवेश ब्रिटिश शासनसँग असन्तुष्ट थिए
अमेरिकी स्वतन्त्रता आन्दोलनको नेतृत्व फ्रान्सेली सम्राटले गरेका थिए
कर तथा प्रतिनिधित्वको प्रश्न महत्वपूर्ण थियो
questions.explanation: अमेरिकी उपनिवेशहरूले ब्रिटिश शासनविरुद्ध स्वतन्त्रताको आन्दोलन चलाएका थिए; फ्रान्सले पछि अमेरिकी पक्षलाई सहयोग गरेको थियो।

questions.subject: नेपाल इतिहास

questions.question: If the columns are transposed left-to-right, which arrangement results?

questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Multiplication is performed before addition: 18 + 18 = 36.

questions.question: What is the greatest common divisor of 48 and 60?
questions.solution: Correct answer: C. The greatest common divisor is 12.

questions.solution: Correct answer: A. The common difference is 3.

questions.question: Is x greater than 10? Statement I: x = 12. Statement II: x is an even number.
questions.solution: Correct answer: A. Statement I directly establishes x = 12.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Three statements are made: A says, 'B is lying.' B says, 'C is lying.' C says, 'A and B are both lying.' If exactly one person is telling the truth, who is truthful?
questions.solution: If B is truthful, C is lying and A is also lying, giving exactly one truthful speaker.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Statements: All policy analysts are researchers. Some researchers are economists. No economist is an auditor. Conclusions: I. Some researchers are not auditors. II. Some policy analysts are not auditors.
questions.solution: The researchers who are economists are not auditors, so I follows. There is no stated existence of policy analysts among those researchers.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A school notices a sudden increase in absenteeism. Courses of action: I. Examine attendance records and consult students and families. II. Punish every absent student immediately without investigation.
questions.solution: Fact-finding is appropriate before deciding on interventions. Blanket punishment without understanding causes is not.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: A box is labeled either Red or Blue. Exactly one of the following statements is true: (1) The box is Red. (2) The box is not Red. What can be concluded?
options: Exactly one statement is true in either case, so the information does not distinguish the color
questions.solution: For either Red or Blue, exactly one of 'Red' and 'not Red' is true. Thus the condition does not identify the color.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Five reports P, Q, R, S and T are arranged from first to last. P is before R. Q is after S. T is before P. Which report can be first?
questions.solution: T must be before P, and P before R; Q must be after S. Therefore T can be first.

questions.category: General Mental Ability, Logical & Analytical Ability
questions.question: Assertion (A): A department should keep a backup of important digital records. Reason (R): Digital records can become inaccessible because of hardware failure or other technical problems.
options: Both A and R are true, and R correctly explains A
Both A and R are true, but R does not explain A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
questions.solution: Technical failure is a direct reason why backup copies are needed.

questions.question: A successful digital service enables users to
options: complete tasks accurately with reasonable effort
questions.solution: The passage defines success through effective task completion.

questions.passage: Energy efficiency can reduce resource use without reducing services. Insulation, efficient appliances and sensible operating practices can cut waste. Small improvements can have a large combined effect across many buildings.
questions.question: What can be inferred?
options: Efficiency matters only at low demand
Efficiency can preserve services while reducing resource use
questions.solution: The passage says services need not decline when resource use falls.

questions.passage: Budgets allocate limited resources among competing priorities. Spending more on one programme can constrain another, although productive investment may create future benefits. Opportunity cost is the alternative use of funds that is forgone.
questions.question: Which question reflects the passage?
options: What alternative use of funds is forgone?
questions.solution: The passage defines opportunity cost through the alternative use forgone.

Choose the word closest in meaning to “obsolete”.
questions.solution: “outdated” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: A statement that contradicts itself is a
In “The reform is likely to alleviate congestion,” what does “alleviate” mean?
questions.solution: The context indicates that “reduce the severity of” is the intended meaning.

questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to “mitigate”.
questions.solution: “lessen” is the closest synonym in this context.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The new lighting will _____ the modern design of the hall.
questions.solution: “complement” means to complete or enhance something; “compliment” means praise.

questions.question: The committee decided to ___ the proposal until more evidence was available.
I ___ this book twice, but I still find it useful.
questions.solution: The present perfect describes an experience up to the present.

questions.question: The manager asked the team to ___ the issue before making a decision.
Each of the proposals ___ carefully examined before approval.
questions.solution: Each is singular and therefore takes was.

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the assistants ___ available today.
questions.solution: With neither...nor, the verb agrees with the nearer subject; assistants is plural, so are is correct.

questions.question: Choose the correct form: 'The department ___ budget was reduced requested an explanation.'
questions.solution: Whose expresses possession: the department's budget.

questions.question: Choose the best transformation: 'No other applicant was as qualified as Maya.'
options: Maya was the most qualified applicant.
Maya was less qualified than every applicant.
Every applicant was more qualified than Maya.
questions.solution: The superlative expresses the same comparison.

questions.question: The teacher said, 'I am checking the papers.' Choose the correct reported form.
options: The teacher said that I am checking the papers.
The teacher said that she is checking the papers tomorrow.
The teacher said that she was checking the papers.
The teacher said that she had checked the papers.
questions.solution: Present continuous normally shifts to past continuous in reported speech.
